summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct prior disclosure of a securities purchase agreement. The company sold approximately 6.7 million shares at $68.73 per share and 6.4 million pre-funded warrants at $68.2799, raising $900 million in gross proceeds for a strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing corrects the aggregate principal amount of notes to $700 million, the conversion price to ~$99.66, and registration rights event days to 60 from 30. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine equity offering with no change of control, restructuring, or activist campaign. The transaction does not trigger any special-situation category; it is a standard equity financing for AI infrastructure deployment in Australia.
